name: Killing Innocent
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the killing of innocent life, emphasizing that human beings are made in the image of God and that shedding man's blood demands just retribution (Genesis 9:6). The commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) underscores the sanctity of life, while God's justice forbids the slaying of the innocent and righteous (Exodus 23:7). The seriousness of taking life is further demonstrated by the prescribed penalty of death for murder (Leviticus 24:17), and the Lord's hatred for actions and judgments that justify wickedness or condemn the just (Proverbs 6:16; 17:15) highlights the divine abhorrence of innocent bloodshed.
